In modern digital editions and cataloging systems, it is classified as section Patthana 8.28 [SuttaCentral]. Like other sections of the *Dukapaṭṭhāna*, it systematically investigates conditional relations (*paccaya*) applied to the dyadic classification of phenomena associated with the bodily knots or bonds (*gantha*).
